anomalies.description: A visible muzzle flash erupts from a firearm held by a person in the center of the frame, indicating active gunfire.
Multiple individuals engage in close-quarters physical combat; one man in black shirt throws a punch while others grapple nearby.

One individual is on the ground while another leans over them with hands placed on their back/shoulders in a controlling manner; a third person (Vin Diesel) observes closely, suggesting a non-consensual restraint or assault.
A bright muzzle flash is visible in the background as a figure fires a weapon; another figure appears to be hit or reacting to gunfire.
Intense hand-to-hand combat continues with multiple participants; figures are seen grappling and striking near vehicles.
A man (Paul Walker) is on the ground, appearing incapacitated, while another person looms over him with hands on his torso—suggesting assault on a helpless victim.
Ongoing melee near a green car; individuals are actively engaged in physical struggle, including one leaning into the vehicle while others fight nearby.

A man lies motionless on the ground while others stand nearby; one individual (in white shirt) appears to be checking or interacting with the prone person, possibly after an attack. The victim appears helpless and unresponsive during this interval.
A man is on the ground while another person stands over him with an arm raised, suggesting active physical combat or assault in progress.

A man in a white shirt is engaged in close-quarters physical combat with another person on the ground; frames f0–f3 show him leaning over and grappling, with visible exertion and contact.; A green classic car is surrounded by multiple individuals in violent motion; frames f4–f7 show people being thrown or colliding near the vehicle, indicating active melee combat involving several participants.
A green classic muscle car crashes violently into a group of people; bodies are thrown through the air and debris is visible, indicating a high-impact collision.

A man is thrown onto the hood of a black car (visible at f11–f12), and in f13 he is seen sliding across the hood as the car moves rapidly—indicating a high-impact collision or intentional vehicle-assisted assault.
A man in a white shirt lunges at and tackles a woman standing beside a car; the impact occurs on the hood of a black vehicle.

A green classic car (possibly a Ford Torino) collides with or is struck by another vehicle during the fight, causing visible motion blur and dust; the black Subaru WRX is also involved in the chaotic movement.
After the initial tackle, the man and woman are shown in close proximity, face-to-face, with intense expressions and physical closeness suggesting continued confrontation or grappling.
